review_output: {"summary":"I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR issues in the six files I was given. The new reference-status label uses the same time rules as the publication guard: a reference counts only if it is verified, has a verification time at or before now, and has no expiry or an expiry after now. As a result, an expired reference, a verified reference with a future verification time, a verified reference with no verification time, and unknown states never get the green \"已驗證\" badge. The current time is captured once (renderedAt) and the label is not used to gate anything. These are unchanged: vendor-scoped authorization, the selected columns, CSRF, revocation, sensitive-reference exclusion, the generic error text, and onboarding keys, conditions and skip behaviour. The page says that platform payment setup is separate from customer collection and does not mean collection is approved. I found two MINOR consistency risks: (1) onboarding copy now says \"有效\" (valid), but its count comes from a loader I was not given; (2) a VENDOR row with a membershipId set could show green while the guard ignores it. I also found one NIT test gap.
